title: Audit documentation with explicit bounds
objective: Inspect every authoritative input in full and compare root/plugin/skill documentation against its implementation metadata. Report each required file/check as inspected, sampled, or not-inspected with reason and source references. Sampling any required input leaves required coverage unmet. Report useful partial findings honestly; do not claim complete coverage or parent acceptance. Publish short progress after meaningful inventory/source-comparison/coverage milestones when report_progress is available, at most one routine checkpoint per minute.

rejected_assumptions: A valid report or sampled audit establishes complete coverage.
exclusions: Parent shell commands are not worker checks.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Fully inspect all eight authoritative files; compare version/plugin inventory, alpha inspect capabilities, and beta accepted format/modalities against metadata.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: Per-file/check coverage status, original source references, reasons for omissions, and explicit unmet coverage.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Ground each finding in original documentation plus implementation metadata and disclose contrary evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: Exact file and statement/field references with observation versus inference distinguished.

checks.description: Statically compare root version/plugin inventory with metadata.json.
Read alpha README and audit skill in full; compare shell instructions with implementation.json inspect.shell.
Read beta README and author skill in full; compare accepted formats/modalities with implementation.json.

constraints: No project writes, shell commands, or external endpoints.
Use write_report for assigned report output.
Describe missing required coverage as a gap, not a completed required check.
stop_conditions: Report inaccessible required input or a scope/permission conflict; do not broaden authority.
